home.exampleNote: Igipimo cy'igereranya gishingiye ku mategeko ariho ubu. Hindura ibyo winjiza hepfo ku nzu yawe bwite.
home.estimatorEyebrow: Ingengo y'imari igereranyije mu ntambwe enye
home.estimatorTitle: Inzu yawe, akarere kawe, ubwiza bwawe.
home.estimatorHint: Nta konti ikenewe. Injira gusa igihe ushaka kubika igisubizo.
home.classesText: Uburyo bumwe ni bwo bukoreshwa mu ngengo y'imari igereranyije hano no muri BOQ y'ipiganwa mu kazi k'abanyamwuga. Ikirango kikubwira icyo umubare ukwiriye.

estimator.invalid: Banza uhitemo ubwoko bw'inyubako n'ingano ikwiye.
estimator.locationHelp: Impinduka z'ibiciro by'akarere ugereranyije n'ahantu h'ifatizo
estimator.bedroomsHelp: Guhindura ibyumba byo kuryamamo bitanga igitekerezo cy'ubuso
estimator.levelNote: Urwego rwa 1 · {{label}} · ±{{pct}} %. Imibare iva muri moteri y'igereranya; igikoresho gisesengura inyandiko cyuzuza gusa ibisubizo byawe.

landing.parserNote: Icyongereza, Ikinyarwanda cyangwa Igifaransa. Igikoresho gisesengura inyandiko cyuzuza gusa ibisubizo byawe; ibiciro byose biva muri moteri.

wizardUi.gfaHelp: Ubuso bwose bw'inzu, amagorofa yose hamwe.
wizardUi.suggest: Gerageza {{m2}} m² ku byumba byo kuryamamo {{n}}
wizardUi.elementsHint: Si itegeko. Siga ku isanzwe kugira ngo hakoreshwe urwego rw'ubwiza rusange wahisemo ({{quality}}).

budget.subtitle: Tubwire amafaranga ufite. Dushakisha ingano n'ubwiza bihuye na yo, hanyuma tukongera kugenzura buri hitamo na moteri y'igereranya (mu ±1 %).
budget.footnote: Ibiciro bishoboka cyane biri mu ±15 % kuri uru rwego. Guhitamo bihindura ihitamo mo igereranya ushobora kunonosora no kubika.

reach.subtitle: Ufite ikibanza n'amafaranga amwe. Reba ibyiciro by'ubwubatsi ingengo y'imari yawe igeraho n'icyo intambwe ikurikira itwara.
reach.reaches: Ingengo y'imari yawe igera kuri {{pct}} % by'ubwubatsi
reach.stagesNote: Ibyiciro bihabwa amafaranga bikurikiranye uko ubwubatsi bugenda. Ibyiciro by'igice byerekana umugabane wahawe amafaranga.

complete.subtitle: Watangiye kubaka? Erekana aho buri cyiciro kigeze n'ibyo wakoresheje. Tugereranya igiciro gisigaye, igiteranyo giteganyijwe n'icyabura.
complete.overspent: Wakoresheje amafaranga arenze agaciro kagereranyijwe k'imirimo yakozwe. Genzura ingano, ibiciro cyangwa imirimo itatanzwe.

compare.emptyText: Fungura igereranya iryo ari ryo ryose ukande “{{compare}}” kugira ngo uryongere hano (kugeza kuri 4).
